1a.note: Own enumeration of full binary trees up to 17 nodes: every one with equal leaf depths is perfect and AVL (4 shapes). Sorted inorder = BST.

1b.note: Own DP over all AVL shapes n<=60: the shallowest node with a missing child has depth growing with n (0,0,1,1,1,2,2,3 at n=1,2,3,5,10,20,40,60), so best case is Omega(log n).

1c.note: Output has n cells: Omega(n); sqrt(n) log n = o(n).

1d.note: Max of a min-heap is one of ~n/2 leaves; raising any single leaf keeps a valid heap (checked), so Omega(n).

1e.note: h=1, f=n, g=n^2 is a counterexample.
